method: For each of the 20 titles, loaded the base shelfcheck-dossiers.txt entry and replayed every existing dossier-overrides-*.js batch (1 through 48, in real load order) using the same last-write-wins Map.set logic dossier-apply.js uses at runtime, to determine the actual EFFECTIVE (live) dossier object -- not just whether an override file happens to mention the title. An entry was classified ALREADY_FIXED only when the effective object was a distinct, already-accurate override (verified against the real game); LIVE_CONTAMINATED (-> REPAIRED) when the effective object was still the contaminated base entry itself.

notesForReviewer: Exactly 20 manifest entries were inspected, selected as the next 20 in the manifest's original array order following the 50 already handled by Batches 1-3.

All 20 were classified ALREADY_FIXED: 16 already-accurate overrides live in dossier-overrides-16.js and 4 in dossier-overrides-17.js -- both batches predate this contamination-repair effort and already supersede the contaminated base shelfcheck-dossiers.txt entry for every one of these 20 titles. Josh has never seen the wrong text for any of them.

No LIVE_CONTAMINATED entries were found in this batch, so no new override file was created (no dossier-overrides-49.js) and no code files (dossier-apply.js, index.html, sw.js) were touched -- only this audit artifact was added.

Qubit's Quest (id 945) deserves a specific note: its existing override is an honest, deliberately non-specific placeholder acknowledging that this identity's exact product/game cannot be confidently identified, rather than a factually wrong description. Per this task's own 'do not invent facts without reliable evidence' principle, this is the correct treatment, not a defect -- it was left untouched rather than replaced with a guessed description.

PWA precache consistency testing was skipped because no new override file was added and sw.js/index.html were not modified, consistent with the task's instruction to run that check only 'if a new override file is added'.
